target: acceptance 1 — an unknown value refuses, naming the valid set
cmd: e=$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" profile "$FIXTURES/profile/banana.md" 2>&1 >/dev/null); c=$?; n=$(printf "%s" "$e" | grep -c "standard"); h=$(printf "%s" "$e" | grep -c "hardened"); d=$(printf "%s" "$e" | grep -c "dark"); printf '{"c":%s,"s":%s,"h":%s,"d":%s}' "$c" "$n" "$h" "$d"
